title: Ambrosia Artemisiaefolia
text: This remedy is characterized by its marked action on the mucous membranes of the nose and eyes. It is especially indicated in cases of hay-fever and common cold. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning. The characteristic symptom is a profuse, watery nasal discharge and a profuse lacrimation. Profuse lacrimation. Eyes red and burning. Itching of the eyelids. Profuse, watery nasal discharge. Sneezing. Stuffed feeling in the nose. Nosebleed. Irritation and rawness in the throat. Hawking of mucus. Cough. Shortness of breath. Wheezing. Violent cough, with a sensation of oppression in the chest. Distended and tender. Flatulence. Chronic diarrhoea. Compare: Allium cepa; Euphrasia; Sabadilla. Tincture to third potency.
